speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury claims others have made millions from the Fury brand while he has made almost nothing and lives in a converted cow shed, although he still wishes them well.
quote: Everybody's made millions out of that brand. I've made fuck all. I'm living in a converted cow shed, you know.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says White’s side made it a fight, insists Matchroom won the battle, and reveals Dana White was not permitted to attend the event in an official role.
quote: The reason Dana didn't come today is he was not permitted to come today.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Fury mocks Anthony Joshua’s team over the 'governor' and 'landlord' talk, insisting the billing proves Joshua is the opponent and Fury is the A-side.
quote: It's Tyson Fury versus his opponent Anthony Joshua.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says the way Dana White’s role was presented would have breached the agreement and significantly affected his team’s strategy for the fight.
quote: What do you expect me to do when it's a breach of the agreement?

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn admits the Fury-Joshua negotiations briefly strained his relationship with Turki Alalshikh and frames the dispute as a contractual battle with Dana White and TKO that Matchroom had to win.
quote: It was a battle with a contract and it was a battle with Dana White and TKO.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury praises Eddie Hearn and Joshua’s team for getting the fight moved back to the UK and claims they have outmaneuvered Dana White in negotiations.
quote: He's [ __ ] Dana White off.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury warns that Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua continuing at this stage of their careers is dangerous and could end in permanent injury.
quote: This has become dangerous for both men.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says he will not return if people fail to recognize his value, and complains that Tyson Fury has not publicly acknowledged the sacrifices and support he provided.
quote: If they don't know my value, well, they'll never see me there again.

speaker: John Fury
summary: Asked about Peter Fury being linked with Anthony Joshua, John Fury says any secret help for Joshua to beat Tyson would make Peter the lowest form of human being and a cockroach.
quote: You're the biggest cockroach of all time.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says he would refuse even a billion dollars to help Anthony Joshua against Tyson Fury and calls anyone doing that an untrustworthy dog.
quote: If you offered me $1 billion dollars to do something like that, I'd run you out this building.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch predicts a loss to Joshua would devastate Fury and possibly define the end of his career.
quote: I think Tyson Fury, if he loses to Anthony Joshua, it's gonna really really upset him and and finish him off.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Fury claims Anthony Joshua was overwhelmed during an earlier sparring session and insists Joshua has never been capable of beating him.
quote: Anthony Joshua put his knees up in that spar and got out the ring after three rounds.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Tyson Fury dismisses Anthony Joshua returning to Ben Davison and says Joshua left Davison because he was not good enough before going back to him.
quote: It's the same Ben Davison that he left because he wasn't good enough one fight ago.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Tyson Fury predicts he will knock out Anthony Joshua in front of 80,000 fans in Cardiff.
quote: I'm going to knock him out in front of 80,000 people at Cardiff.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn reacts to Dana White’s press conference by saying White looked mentally overwhelmed and describing the scene as a car crash.
quote: He looked cooked, like mentally cooked.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn says Zuffa cannot be involved in promoting the event because it would be a contractual breach, then warns a live exchange with Dana White would be a car crash.
quote: Do you honestly think these people would allow me to converse with Dana White up there on that platform and that presser?

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn dismisses Dana White’s explanation for missing the press conference and calls the past week a major PR failure for White’s side.
quote: What's happened to them over the last 7 days has been one of the greatest PR disasters in boxing.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says Dana White and TKO handled the Joshua-Fury situation wrongly by publicly claiming promotional involvement, a venue and a U.S. location that did not materialize.
quote: You thought you had the fight in America, you told the world you knew where it was, you told the world you'd signed the venue contract.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Fury says Turki Alalshikh, as the person funding the event, can involve Dana White or any promoter he chooses and claims others failed to make the fight for a decade.
quote: I don't care if Santa Claus promotes it.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Fury dismisses Eddie Hearn's claim that he is scared of Anthony Joshua, calling Hearn a nuisance and saying the event is simply a professional boxing job.
quote: Bit of a nugget, Roelly.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn says Fury has been respectful toward him, then suggests Max Kellerman’s explanation of Dana White’s role with Turki Alalshikh sounded like a prepared setup line.
quote: That was a set up line.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn warns Netflix not to overly Americanize the Fury–Joshua fight, arguing that its importance to British boxing is its greatest selling point.
quote: the biggest fight in British boxing history.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says Tyson Fury can appear obnoxious on Instagram but is surprisingly charming and likeable when met face-to-face.
quote: What a prick.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says the dispute is driven by the disrespect shown to him, accusing the opposing side of arrogance and insisting they cannot simply take over boxing.
quote: They don't like it when things don't go their way.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn says Tyson Fury’s British boxing licence status is up to him, but predicts Fury will not seek one while insisting VADA testing is enough for the Joshua fight.
quote: I think with his history, I don't think he'll be looking to become a British boxing license holder, but his prerogative up to him.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury argues that Fury–Joshua should have happened when both men were champions and now represents a lucrative fight driven by public demand rather than a true legacy contest.
quote: This is just a well- paid job, isn't it?

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says the Joshua-Fury fight would have favored Tyson more years ago, but Tyson’s reduced movement now makes him vulnerable to Joshua.
quote: And if you don't move in front of AJ, you get Ngannou.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury dismisses concerns over Tyson Fury’s labored win over Mariusz Wach and says Tyson may be disguising his true level before the Joshua fight.
quote: What you see with him is not what you're getting.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury attacks Dana White for not attending and says White should have forced his way into the promotion rather than staying away.
quote: He should have stood. [ __ ] you, Eddie. I'm coming.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury gives Eddie Hearn credit for getting his way without funding the fight, says Tyson Fury only cares about fighting Anthony Joshua, and predicts more drama.
quote: He's not put a dollar in and he's got all his own way.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says Turki Alalshikh’s health concerns explain why the fight was pushed through, credits him for making Anthony Joshua vs Tyson Fury possible, and warns boxing would be lost without him.
quote: without him AJ Joshua would never have been made

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says he wanted Tyson Fury to retire earlier and that the Francis Ngannou fight confirmed to him that Tyson should not continue boxing.
quote: But when I seen him fight Francis Ngannou, that sealed the deal for me.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua fight makes financial sense but argues both fighters are nowhere near their best anymore.
quote: But the no side of it, you've got two athletes nowhere near the best, you know, and they're going to do what they're going to do and full credit to them.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says Anthony Joshua has the British public and judging environment in his favor, claiming Tyson Fury would need a knockout just to get a draw.
quote: AJ's only got to stand up near the final belt to win. Tyson has to knock him out to get a draw.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury criticizes Ben Davison for working with Anthony Joshua, saying Tyson Fury gave him his biggest opportunity and Davison has now traded him.
quote: Tyson gave the biggest leg up in the world. And what's he done now? Traded him.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says Dana White let Eddie Hearn dominate him, claiming White obeyed Hearn like a little boy and that Fury himself has more courage.
quote: Told him to stay where he was like a little boy and he did.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says he may never attend another press conference again because he feels unrecognized and discarded after building Tyson Fury’s platform and supporting him from his amateur days.
quote: You'll probably never see me at a press conference again.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury questions Peter Fury's explanation that Joshua only rang him for general advice, arguing the only advice Joshua could want would be on Tyson Fury.
quote: The only advice he could have wanted is on Tyson, isn't it?

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: During the face-off exchange, Eddie Hearn says he accepted Fury being listed first to prevent the fight from falling apart, while Fury accuses the other side of trying to avoid the bout and Anthony Joshua insists he would fight anywhere.
quote: You have tried everything to get out this fight.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch reports that Fury has predicted a knockout of Joshua and says he hopes the fight becomes an all-out exchange in the center of the ring.
quote: I'm going to catch him and when I do it's going to be Curtains.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Carl Froch says Anthony Joshua looked badly faded after being dropped by a poor opponent and argues it is hard to back him against Tyson Fury on recent form.
quote: So AJ's at the end of his career, literally hanging on to the edge of the cliff with his fingernails dragging this fight out of him.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch compares Fury and Joshua’s performances against Francis Ngannou and says Joshua has the power to end the fight if he lands clean.
quote: If AJ comes out and he can land, this fight's over.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch predicts Tyson Fury will beat Anthony Joshua because of his natural ability despite no longer being as sharp as he once was.
quote: I've got to say that Tyson Fury beats Anthony Joshua.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch argues Eddie Hearn appears to have won the dispute with Dana White after White was absent and the Fury-Joshua fight landed in the UK.
quote: It just feels a little bit like Edd's won the argument here.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch mocks John Fury for being absent from the press conference and calls him an embarrassment after his previous talk.
quote: This is just a confirmation that the guy's totally full of pure gobshite, which I've said before.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Fury dismisses the dispute over the promotion of his fight with Anthony Joshua, saying Turki Alalshikh is effectively in charge and that the Dana White-Eddie Hearn issue does not concern him.
quote: The Dana White stuff is mainly between him and Eddie Hearn.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Frank Warren dismisses the Peter Fury storyline and suggests Anthony Joshua returning to Ben Davison and involving Peter Fury shows he is looking for reassurance, unlike Tyson Fury.
quote: I look at that and I think it's like you're looking for reassurance.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Frank Warren says he has seen doubt in Anthony Joshua, references the Daniel Dubois fight, and predicts Fury vs Joshua will play out similarly with a special Fury performance.
quote: And this fight I feel is going to go the same way.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren says the Kabayel-Hrgovic event will sell out and predicts Tyson Fury's upcoming fight will also sell out without any need for hype.
quote: That fight will sell out. It needs zero hyping.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren says Fury was contractually expected to fight in Ireland but voluntarily agreed to come to Britain, where Queensberry and Sela arranged the venue and local-authority deal.
quote: Tyson didn't have to fight in the UK. He had a contract that said to fight in Ireland.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says the press conference would have been more entertaining with him in the middle, but Tyson Fury would not want him provoking the fighters.
quote: Tyson Fury is not going to want me up there goating those two and trying to get things rocking.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn says Tyson Fury did not enroll in VADA under the terms of Joshua’s agreement, but accepts Fury’s side did not have the same reciprocal clause and calls that a mistake.
quote: Well, he didn't enroll in VADA under the terms of our agreement.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says Dana White reacted badly because he lacked answers, and points to Max Kellerman’s broadcast explanation that White is not the promoter of the event.
quote: Dana White is not the promoter of the event.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn downplays Anthony Joshua’s links to Peter Fury, says Joshua speaks to many boxing people, and indicates Ben Davison is expected to lead the corner on December 11.
quote: I don't think there's any imminent plans to bring Peter Fury into the team, but that's down to Anthony Joshua.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says Joshua’s previous fight gave him a wake-up call and that AJ now knows he must break Fury down and knock him out.
quote: Tell me how I'm going to break this guy down and knock him out and let's get on with it.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says seeing Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua face to face was remarkable and calls their matchup the biggest fight in boxing.
quote: It is the biggest fight in boxing.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn dismisses Fury’s A-side talk as waffle, says Fury cared more about top billing, and explains Joshua did not complain about being second on the poster.
quote: Fury talks some waffle sometimes.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says White could have attended as a spectator, calls the situation embarrassing, and predicts many future battles between Matchroom and Zuffa.
quote: There'll be loads of battles, by the way, between Matchroom and Zuffa.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn defends reporter Jack Fig’s questioning of Dana White and says White’s side are control freaks who are not boxing people.
quote: These guys, they're control freaks. They can't be pressed. They can't be questioned.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn closes by billing the upcoming Fury fight on Netflix as the biggest fight in British boxing history.
quote: It's the biggest fight in the history of British boxing, December 11th, live on Netflix.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle suggests Turki Alalshikh may have forced Eddie Hearn to soften his stance on Dana White and predicts White will still be involved in the Fury-Joshua promotion.
quote: I think we will find that Dana White will be involved with this.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Ingle compares Joshua’s approach to other fighters seeking inside information and says it seems strange that Joshua is relying on others instead of himself.
quote: it just seems a bit strange that Joshua is kind of resorting a certain degree to other people instead of relying on his own ability.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Ingle reacts to Tyson Fury and Shane Fury calling Ben Davison a traitor, saying he does not believe it was a joke and senses real animosity.
quote: I don't think it was a joke. I think they actually mean it.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Ingle suggests that if Fury had paid and treated Ben Davison well enough, Davison might have refused to train Anthony Joshua against him.
quote: If you don't pay people the proper money, then there's going to be no loyalty there, is it?

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle argues there is no hidden training secret for Anthony Joshua to beat Tyson Fury, and says he actually thought Fury beat Oleksandr Usyk in their first fight.
quote: I did actually think that Tyson won the first one.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Tyson Fury says he barely knows David Benavidez but would fight anyone, including a potential Joshua replacement, if the money is right.
quote: There's nobody out there that I wouldn't take for the right amount of money.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Fury says he has retired many times but will keep fighting indefinitely, then refuses to directly predict whether he will knock out Joshua.
quote: I'll be fighting until the wheels fall off this and then I'll get a puncture repair kit and fix it and put it back on.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn says the Fury-Joshua fight is on and frames the Dana White feud, Joshua's training team, and Fury's complaints about fight timing as side narratives building the event.
quote: The other one is the fight with me with Dana White.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn criticizes the AJ-Fury press conference format, saying a broadcaster should not run it and admitting he would be biased toward Anthony Joshua.
quote: Tyson Fury's not going to let me get up there and start moderating a presser, and I wouldn't.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says Dana White has an open invitation to attend the Birmingham event featuring Ben Whittaker, despite jokingly denying that White is definitely coming.
quote: There is an open invitation for Dana White to come to to Birmingham on Saturday.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn says Ariel Helwani stirred up Ben Whitaker's Zuffa comments and reveals that Dana White's side has reached out to Whitaker.
quote: By the way, they have reached out to him.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says Conor Benn was out of contract because he trusted him, while Ben Whitaker still has two years left, and accuses Ariel Helwani of trying to cause trouble because he dislikes Dana White.
quote: Connor Benn was out of contract. My mistake because I trusted him.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says he offered several Matchroom fighters as possible Manny Pacquiao opponents and wants Joe Cordina on the card against Pacquiao, Abdullah Mason or Sam Noakes.
quote: If you need an opponent for Manny Pacquiao, we've got Jack Catterall, Connor Walker, Lewis Crocker, and Joe Cordina.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn says Tyson Fury should apologise for offending him with comments about his father, but claims Fury cannot bring himself to do it and says he has no interest in sitting down with him.
quote: I just don't no interest in sitting and talking to him.

speaker: Spence Oliver
summary: Spence Oliver and John Fury discuss the proposed Tyson Fury–Anthony Joshua fight, stressing that the public announcement does not mean the bout is fully secured.
quote: Press conferences don't mean to say you're fighting.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury dismisses reading too much into Anthony Joshua being dropped by Christian Pringa, claiming Joshua was mentally off and not fully focused that night.
quote: I seen him walk into the ring like he wasn't really sure. He was more out than in.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says Joshua will be fully focused against Tyson because his career is effectively on the line.
quote: When he's fighting Tyson now, he knows his full life's on the line.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says Anthony Joshua may have been mentally affected by a traumatic car-crash incident before fighting, while still giving him credit for winning.
quote: Can you imagine the nerves though after you've been in a car crash watching your mate be beheaded on the road.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says contracts should not have stopped Dana White if he had the product everyone wanted, and argues the Fury side conceded too much.
quote: I wouldn't have [ __ ] conceded.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says Tyson Fury was quiet as a child, so he deliberately taught him to be loud, brash, confident and controversial to attract attention.
quote: You know when I realized he had a god-given talent, I made a voice for him.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says he will not attend Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua and does not condone Tyson taking the fight.
quote: I'm going to be straight with you. No, no, no, no.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says he will not attend the Cardiff fight because he dislikes the boxing scene and finds it too stressful.
quote: Let me tell you, you more chance of seeing a cow flying than me bothering with it.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says his loyalty is now primarily to Tommy Fury and that he and Tommy will only return to boxing for lucrative opportunities, describing the sport as a stepping stone rather than a permanent commitment.
quote: Boxing was only ever going to be a stepping stone for us, and we've had a bit of good luck with it.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says he is done with boxing media appearances, will only work with loyal people, and is no part of the coming Fury-Joshua spectacle.
quote: I'm the creator of all of it.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Carl Froch says Turki Alalshikh deserves credit for funding the fight and suggests Eddie Hearn has gained the upper hand over Dana White, who is absent from the press conference.
quote: Eddie Hearn's probably got one over Dana White because Dana White's not here.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch says the face-off lacked genuine hostility but confirms that Fury and Joshua are finally scheduled to fight on December 11.
quote: This press conference just solidifies the fact that these two will be coming together on December 11th.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch says Fury-Joshua gives closure on who was the better British heavyweight, while stressing both men have losses and Joshua’s defeats were worse.
quote: Tyson Fury will tell you that he won them fights which which he didn't.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Carl Froch says Anthony Joshua may bring his best performance but probably still will not have enough, unless he lands his right hand.
quote: If he lands the right hand, this fight's over, maybe that's that is the case.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Fury questions Joshua's toughness by pointing to the repeated knockdowns he suffered against Andy Ruiz, while stopping short of saying his punch resistance has declined.
quote: He got bladed all over the ring.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Frank Warren says Fury vs Joshua will come down to who can handle pressure, take punishment, and that both men's careers may be judged by the fight.
quote: Your career probably be judged on this fight.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren argues that views do not constitute successful promotion unless they lead to ticket sales, claiming his events consistently sell out apart from one affected by an England match.
quote: If you've got 200,000 people watching an interview and it doesn't translate into selling tickets, that ain't promotion.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren dismisses the controversy involving Dana White and Eddie Hearn, saying the focus should be on Fury, Joshua, ticket sales and the enormous purses involved.
quote: Forget all this negative. Who cares? I don't care about any of it.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren rejects newspaper fears that a late fight in Cardiff will cause chaos, arguing that spectators will remain inside the stadium and will not create a dangerous street crowd.
quote: It's not going to be murder because they're going to be in the stadium, not going to be walking about the streets.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren attacks the negativity surrounding the event and emphasizes that major investors and a television company have committed substantial money to make the fight happen.
quote: Why do we want it be negative?

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says the main delay around the fight was Fury getting VADA paperwork signed after the announcement, more than the Dana White controversy.
quote: People talk about the Dana White thing, ultimately the biggest thing was getting that paperwork signed.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says DAZN would likely allow him to go back and forth with Dana White, and claims White has boosted his profile in America.
quote: Dana is doing a brilliant job for me this last month.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn criticizes the Fury-Joshua press conference format as too staged and says promoters should be allowed to run it to create more energy.
quote: They should just let me do it.

speaker: Derek Chisora
summary: Derek Chisora says he wanted the fight in the UK and backs Eddie Hearn over Dana White as the better promoter.
quote: Dana White's only promoted UFC. That's it.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle says the Fury-Joshua press-conference intro felt excessive because the fight would have been bigger years ago and both men are now near the end of their careers.
quote: But at this point where, you know, it's like they're at the end of their careers.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle says Anthony Joshua may be trying to gain insight into Tyson Fury from Ben Davison and Peter Fury, but doubts even they truly know Fury’s mindset.
quote: I don't think they'll still know the depths of and the mindset of what Tyson Fury is capable of.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: After the interviewer raises the idea that Joshua may have put Peter Fury in a difficult position by making their talks public, Ingle says a fighter can only have one master.
quote: a dog can only have one master, can't they?

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Ingle says elite fighters like Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua hold the power over trainers, but poor pay can destroy loyalty.
quote: If they've been paying them peanuts then there's never going to be any loyalty is there.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Ingle argues that trainers will not give their best when fighters underpay and undermine them, comparing it to his family's experience with Naseem Hamed.
quote: Are we ever going to deliver the best to the best of our abilities what we can deliver when people are taking a piss and undermining you by paying you money?

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle says he personally would not choose to train a boxer specifically to face one of his former fighters, suggesting discomfort with Ben Davison training Anthony Joshua against Tyson Fury.
quote: I wouldn't, you know, purposely, you know, go and train a fighter who, you know, being up against one of mine type of thing.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle says Joshua may have learned something from visiting other camps, but warns boxing is full of charlatans and jokingly suggests Fury could counter by hiring Joshua’s former trainers.
quote: I've seen a lot of charlatans, a lot of bleggers, a lot of conmen.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle says Tyson Fury’s extreme self-belief means he relies on himself rather than looking for a magic formula, and argues this is what separates Fury from Anthony Joshua.
quote: Tyson's not looking for the magic formula.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Tyson Fury rejects the idea that he was unhappy with the negotiations, saying he never complained despite the fight being considered unlikely days earlier.
quote: I've never said a word about anything.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says he will not control the Fury undercard but has an agreement to place fighters on it, while Dana White has ruled out Manny Pacquiao versus Shakur Stevenson.
quote: I have an agreement with those guys that we'll have some fighters on the card.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury credits Joshua’s recovery and finish after being dropped, while arguing Pringa had real knockout power and could naturally hurt AJ.
quote: That's world class power that, you know what I'm saying?

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury predicts Joshua will have to overcome his demons and be fully focused to win.
quote: In this case I think he's going to put his demons to bed because he has to.

speaker: Carl Froch
summary: Froch says Fury can be inconsistent but expects him to be fully focused for Joshua, while noting Turki Alalshikh’s money and Netflix’s audience are driving the fight.
quote: He's the reason this fight's happening, let's be honest.

speaker: Tyson Fury
summary: Fury says he did not watch Joshua's difficult fight because he was traveling and argues that a single punch can change any heavyweight bout.
quote: They say it takes 6 lbs of pressure to knock a man out.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Frank Warren says he has no animosity toward Anthony Joshua but makes clear that he is backing Tyson Fury.
quote: I ain't got no animosity to him is what it is, but I'm with Tyson.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren distances himself and Eddie Hearn from the event's promotional format, saying the investors chose how the fight would be presented and that soundbites are being sought.
quote: I'm not the promoter of the fight. Eddie's not the promoter of the fight.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren says the broadcasters will determine the ring-walk time and warns that the event must be made commercially successful for the television company or it may not return.
quote: You want to make it a success for them.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says the press conference format prevented a livelier back-and-forth with Fury and that he would not force a shouting match while Fury stayed respectful.
quote: You got to let people speak rather than just ask them a question.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Hearn says Fury is always nice to him in person despite joking on camera that people should give Hearn abuse.
quote: Every time I've been around Tyson Fury, he couldn't have been nicer to me.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle criticizes fighters who keep changing trainers, saying it suggests they are looking for a secret that does not exist in boxing.
quote: When I look at fighters who've had several trainers, I'm not saying I ain't really got much respect for them because it just makes me feel they're a bit flaky.

speaker: Boxing King Media presenter
summary: The presenter says Fury and Joshua are risking their legacies because the loser will face severe criticism, while noting that both are willing to take the fight for substantial money.
quote: The loser is going to get hammered.

speaker: Eddie Hearn
summary: Eddie Hearn describes watching Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury come face-to-face, saying seeing Fury's eyes during the staredown was a powerful moment after a long wait.
quote: I could just see Fury's eyes, you know, and it was pretty made the hairs on the neck stand up a bit.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury predicts Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua could go the full 12 rounds because both men are late in their careers and likely to manage the pace.
quote: I think they could go 12. Yeah, I really do.

speaker: John Fury
summary: John Fury says he has only met Anthony Joshua once but respects him and likes the way Joshua carries himself.
quote: The man showed me the respect and I showed it him and I do like the kid.

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Asked about Anthony Joshua’s proposed punch-machine competition to decide who walks second, Warren predicts Tyson Fury would win the chin-related contest.
quote: I would think Tyson. We'll find out on the night, won't we?

speaker: Frank Warren
summary: Warren jokes that he and Eddie Hearn should settle their rivalry on a punch machine, claiming he would need the machine adjusted to avoid embarrassing Hearn.
quote: I don't want, you know, I don't want to embarrass him.

speaker: Dominic Ingle
summary: Dominic Ingle comments on the Fury-Joshua face-off, saying Fury may be slightly taller and likely has the bigger reach.
quote: You know, I think Tyson's got the the bigger reach.
